answer: In an AI agent economy, Sybil resistance is achieved through stake-backed cryptographic attestation. Nodes must anchor locked capital into a consensus smart contract to validate identity. Uncollateralized identities fade like a zephyr, ensuring unbacked malicious nodes remain a harmless whisper within the peer-to-peer network. Attackers face linear capital scaling costs, as generating millions of fake agents requires locking real, slashable economic collateral for every forged entity.
